  d DATE NOT NULL := SYSDATE;
  s hr.employees.salary%TYPE;
  r hr.employees%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
  n := n + 1;
END;

================================================================================
Exception declaration and pragma
================================================================================

DECLARE
  e EXCEPTION;
  PRAGMA EXCEPTION_INIT(e, -20001);
BEGIN
  RAISE e;
EXCEPTION
  WHEN e OR NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
    NULL;
  WHEN pkg.err THEN
    RAISE;
  WHEN OTHERS THEN
    RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20002, 'failed: ' || SQLERRM);
END;

================================================================================
Loops
================================================================================

BEGIN
  LOOP
    i := i + 1;
    EXIT WHEN i > 10;
    CONTINUE WHEN MOD(i, 2) = 0;
  END LOOP;
  WHILE i > 0 LOOP
    i := i - 1;
  END LOOP;
  <<l>>
  FOR i IN REVERSE 1..n LOOP
    EXIT l;
  END LOOP l;
  FOR r IN c(1) LOOP
    NULL;
  END LOOP;
  FOR r IN (SELECT a FROM t) LOOP
    GOTO done;
  END LOOP;
  <<done>>
  NULL;
END;

BEGIN
  FOR i IN 1..3, REPEAT i * 2 WHILE i < 100 LOOP
    NULL;
  END LOOP;
  FOR i MUTABLE PLS_INTEGER IN 1..10 BY 2 WHEN MOD(i, 3) = 0 LOOP
    NULL;
  END LOOP;
  FOR i, v IN PAIRS OF t LOOP
    NULL;
  END LOOP;
  FOR v IN VALUES OF t LOOP
    NULL;
  END LOOP;
END;

  EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'SELECT a FROM t WHERE b = :1' INTO x USING y;
  EXECUTE IMMEDIATE s BULK COLLECT INTO l USING IN a, OUT b, IN OUT c;
  EXECUTE IMMEDIATE s USING a RETURNING INTO b;
END;

Cursor statements

BEGIN
  OPEN c;
  OPEN c(1, 2);
  OPEN cv FOR SELECT * FROM t;
  OPEN cv FOR s USING a, b;
  FETCH c INTO a, b;
  FETCH cv BULK COLLECT INTO l LIMIT 100;
  FETCH c INTO r.a, t(i);
  CLOSE c;
  IF c%ISOPEN AND SQL%ROWCOUNT > 0 THEN
    x := SQL%BULK_ROWCOUNT(1) + SQL%BULK_EXCEPTIONS(1).ERROR_INDEX;
  END IF;
END;

================================================================================
FORALL
================================================================================

BEGIN
  FORALL i IN 1..l.COUNT SAVE EXCEPTIONS
    INSERT INTO t VALUES l(i);
  FORALL i IN INDICES OF l
    UPDATE t SET ROW = l(i) WHERE id = l(i).id;
  FORALL i IN VALUES OF idx
    DELETE FROM t WHERE id = l(i);
END;

================================================================================
SQL in PL/SQL
================================================================================

BEGIN
  SELECT a, b INTO x, y FROM t WHERE id = 1;
  SELECT a BULK COLLECT INTO l FROM t;
  INSERT INTO t (a) VALUES (x) RETURNING id INTO n;
  INSERT INTO t VALUES r;
  UPDATE t SET a = 1 WHERE CURRENT OF c;
  DELETE FROM t WHERE a = x;
  MERGE INTO t USING s ON (t.id = s.id) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.a = s.a;
  SAVEPOINT sp;
  ROLLBACK TO sp;
  COMMIT;
END;

---

  $IF $$debug $THEN
    dbms_output.put_line($$PLSQL_UNIT || ':' || $$PLSQL_LINE);
  $ELSIF dbms_db_version.ver_le_12 $THEN
    NULL;
  $ELSE
    $ERROR 'unsupported' $END
  $END
END;

================================================================================
CREATE PROCEDURE

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE hr.raise_salary (
  p_id IN employees.employee_id%TYPE,
  p_amount IN OUT NOCOPY NUMBER,
  p_flag OUT BOOLEAN,
  p_note VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL
) AUTHID DEFINER IS
  l_old NUMBER;
BEGIN
  UPDATE employees SET salary = salary + p_amount WHERE employee_id = p_id;
END raise_salary;
/

SQL macro
================================================================================

CREATE FUNCTION m (t DBMS_TF.TABLE_T) RETURN VARCHAR2 SQL_MACRO(TABLE) IS
BEGIN
  RETURN q'{SELECT * FROM t}';
END;

================================================================================
CREATE PACKAGE
================================================================================

CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE emp_mgmt AUTHID CURRENT_USER AS
  TYPE emp_t IS TABLE OF employees%ROWTYPE;
  g_count NUMBER := 0;
  no_emp EXCEPTION;
  CURSOR c RETURN employees%ROWTYPE;
  FUNCTION hire (name VARCHAR2) RETURN NUMBER;
  PROCEDURE fire (id NUMBER);
  PRAGMA SERIALLY_REUSABLE;
END emp_mgmt;
/

================================================================================
CREATE PACKAGE BODY
================================================================================

CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE BODY emp_mgmt AS
  CURSOR c RETURN employees%ROWTYPE IS SELECT * FROM employees;
  FUNCTION hire (name VARCHAR2) RETURN NUMBER IS
    id NUMBER;
  BEGIN
    INSERT INTO employees (last_name) VALUES (name) RETURNING employee_id INTO id;
    RETURN id;
  END hire;
  PROCEDURE fire (id NUMBER) IS
    PRAGMA AUTONOMOUS_TRANSACTION;
  BEGIN
    DELETE FROM employees WHERE employee_id = id;
    COMMIT;
  END fire;
BEGIN
  g_count := 0;
END emp_mgmt;
/

================================================================================
CREATE TYPE BODY
================================================================================

CREATE OR REPLACE TYPE BODY person_t AS
  CONSTRUCTOR FUNCTION person_t (SELF IN OUT NOCOPY person_t, name VARCHAR2) RETURN SELF AS RESULT IS
  BEGIN
    SELF.name := name;
    RETURN;
  END;
  MAP MEMBER FUNCTION get_name RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
  BEGIN
    RETURN name;
  END get_name;
  OVERRIDING MEMBER PROCEDURE show IS
  BEGIN
    (SELF AS base_t).show;
  END;
  STATIC FUNCTION make RETURN person_t IS
  BEGIN
    RETURN person_t('x');
  END;
END;
/

================================================================================
CREATE TRIGGER on a table
================================================================================

CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER emp_biu
  BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF salary, job_id ON employees
  REFERENCING NEW AS n OLD AS o
  FOR EACH ROW
  WHEN (n.salary > 0)
DECLARE
  d NUMBER;
BEGIN
  IF INSERTING THEN
    :n.id := emp_seq.NEXTVAL;
  END IF;
END;
/

CREATE TRIGGER v_ioi INSTEAD OF INSERT ON v FOR EACH ROW
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO t VALUES (:new.a);
END;

================================================================================
Compound trigger
================================================================================

CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER c_t FOR UPDATE OF salary ON employees COMPOUND TRIGGER
  n PLS_INTEGER := 0;
  BEFORE STATEMENT IS
  BEGIN
    n := 0;
  END BEFORE STATEMENT;
  AFTER EACH ROW IS
  BEGIN
    n := n + 1;
  END AFTER EACH ROW;
END c_t;
/

---

================================================================================
Nested subprograms
================================================================================

DECLARE
  PROCEDURE p (x NUMBER);
  FUNCTION f (x NUMBER) RETURN NUMBER IS
  BEGIN
    RETURN x;
  END f;
  PROCEDURE p (x NUMBER) IS
  BEGIN
    NULL;
  END;
BEGIN
  p(f(1));
END;

WITH FUNCTION
================================================================================

WITH
  FUNCTION f (n NUMBER) RETURN NUMBER IS
  BEGIN
    RETURN n * 2;
  END;
  PROCEDURE p IS
  BEGIN
    NULL;
  END;
  c AS (SELECT 1 a FROM dual)
SELECT f(a) FROM c;
/

================================================================================
ALTER and DROP of units
================================================================================

ALTER PROCEDURE p COMPILE;
ALTER PACKAGE p COMPILE BODY REUSE SETTINGS;
ALTER TRIGGER t DISABLE;
ALTER TYPE t COMPILE SPECIFICATION;
DROP PACKAGE BODY p;
DROP TYPE BODY t;
DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS t;
